item.title: Report: GTA 6 Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab Walkthrough: How to Rob the Armoured Van
item.description: Step‑by‑step guide from VideogamesChronicle on completing the Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab mission in GTA 6, showing how to stop, crash and loot the Gruppe 6 armoured van.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Players Are Already Sharing Early Stunt Videos, Eurogamer Reports
item.description: Eurogamer reports that GTA 6 players are already sharing plane and vehicle stunt videos just days after launch, including a claimed narrow-gap Mallard flight and motorbike jumps. The publication frames these as early community highlights, not official Rockstar announcements.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Vehicle Guide: Cars, Aircraft & Driving Tips
item.description: Game Rant publishes a GTA 6 vehicle hub covering how to steal, purchase, maintain, and drive cars and aircraft in Leonida, including vehicle management and driving mechanics.

item.title: Report: GameSpot Reports GTA 6's Mandy May Be Hiding Serial Killer Clues
item.description: GameSpot reports that GTA 6 players found clues suggesting Mandy could be a serial killer, including a severed finger in her sink and a grave near her home. Rockstar has not confirmed the theory.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 on Xbox Gets Reported VRR Edge Over PS5, per RockstarINTEL
item.description: RockstarINTEL, citing Digital Foundry, reports that GTA 6 runs inside a 120Hz VRR container on Xbox Series X|S while PS5 VRR needs 48FPS-plus; the claims are unofficial.

item.title: Report: GameSpot Reports GTA 6 Gym Trick Lets Jason and Lucia Train Together to Save Time
item.description: GameSpot reports that Grand Theft Auto 6 players can cut gym workout time by exercising Jason and Lucia as a pair, with both protagonists gaining muscle simultaneously. The finding is presented as a player discovery, not an official Rockstar announcement.

item.title: Report: GTA VI Hands-On Gameplay Impressions
item.description: RockstarINTEL’s first hands‑on impressions of GTA VI describe a cinematic experience that rivals Red Dead Redemption 2, with top‑tier acting, fluid animations, and an immersive open world called Leonida that feels truly lived‑in. item.title: Report: How To Get The Exclusive GTA VI Tropical Weapon Skins
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports GTA 6's two Tropical weapon patterns unlock by linking your Rockstar Games account to your console account, then checking the Cosmetics/Wraps menu at Ammu-Nation in Leonida.

item.title: Report: GameSpot Details Xbox Region Trick to Play GTA 6 Early
item.description: GameSpot details an Xbox region-change trick that may let players access GTA 6 in New Zealand time before the U.S. launch, with caveats about Microsoft policy and no guarantee of success.

item.title: Discord Launches Vice City-Themed Takeover Ahead of GTA VI
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that Discord has partnered with Rockstar Games for a limited-time Vice City experience ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI. The takeover adds a Vice City color theme, custom app icon, and special Display Name Style to Discord, available on desktop and mobile through Quest Home and app

item.title: GTA 6 Hacker Arion Kurtaj Pleads Guilty to 2022 Rockstar Breach
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, 21, pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court to hacking Rockstar Games and leaking nearly 100 GTA 6 gameplay videos in 2022, along with other cybercrimes. Sentencing is pending as GTA 6 approaches its November 19 release.

item.title: Free GTA VI via Twitch and Kick Launch Giveaways
item.description: Learn how Twitch and Kick are offering free GTA VI codes through launch promotions, including Kick's 10,000 Sunset Reward Case and Twitch's daily drops.

item.title: Report: GTA VI Game Length Leaked by Reviewer
item.description: A reviewer has leaked estimates for GTA VI's game length, citing Insider Gaming via RockstarINTEL.

item.title: Report: New GTA 6 Gameplay Clips Circulate One Week Before the November 19 Launch
item.description: Happy Gamer reports that new GTA 6 gameplay clips are circulating online roughly one week ahead of the November 19 launch. The footage has not been confirmed as official Rockstar material, and details about its origin remain unclear.

item.title: Report: GTA VI Album Track List Reportedly Leaks
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that a retail employee’s video shows the rear cover of the GTA VI album vinyl, listing 34 tracks. Rockstar Games has not confirmed the list, and the report relies on an unverified retail source.

item.title: GTA VI Update 01.002.000 Rolls Out on PS5 and Xbox Ahead of Launch
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games has released a new pre-launch GTA VI update, 01.002.000, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The outlet cites X accounts for rollout timing, affected files, and update sizes; official patch notes were not included in the report.

item.title: GTA VI Is Still a Mystery Even to Grand Theft Auto’s Original Creators
item.description: Dave Jones and Brian Baglow, key creators of the original Grand Theft Auto, reveal they have not played GTA VI before its release, as shared in a BBC News interview reported by RockstarINTEL. The discussion covers their wait for release and memories of the series' origins.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Physical Copies in PEGI Regions Vulnerable to Flashlight Code Theft
item.description: GameSpot reports that physical "code-in-box" copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 sold in PEGI regions print the download code on the inside of the cover, making it visible through the closed case with a flashlight. The flaw could allow thieves to steal codes before purchase. North American copies reportedl

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Map Leaks via Collector's Box Sold Early at Selfridges UK
item.description: A Grand Theft Auto VI Collector's Edition box was reportedly sold early at a Selfridges store in Manchester, revealing the game's official map ahead of the November 19 release. Photos shared on social media show the folded map displaying new location names such as Southwind and Pelican Valley.

item.title: Report: Guardian Interview Reveals New GTA 6 Gameplay Details From Rockstar North Visit
item.description: The Guardian's Keza MacDonald toured Rockstar North and reported new gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto VI, including protagonist Jason Duval eating a hot dog while holding a beer and a donut, realistic liquid physics when running with a six-pack, and insights into the studio's Miami research tri

item.title: GTA Online Event Week: Last One Before GTA 6 (Nov 12-18)
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports the November 12-18 GTA Online event week features Kortz Center Heist rewards, double Priority File payouts, casino prizes, test rides and dealer offers.

item.title: Rockstar Games Confirms New GTA VI Footage Shared by Miami Social Account
item.description: Rockstar Games reposted a 20-second Grand Theft Auto VI clip from the Miami-based Instagram account Only In Dade, confirming its authenticity. The footage shows Vice City streets, protagonists Jason and Lucia, high NPC density, and vehicles matching recent Rockstar marketing events.

item.title: Rockstar Games Launcher Adds Revamped Chat Overlay with Discord Integration and Streamer Mode
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games has released a new update for the Rockstar Games Launcher (RGL), introducing a completely reworked chat overlay. According to the publication, the update includes updated visual designs, new social and achievement functionality, and full controller support.

item.title: Rockstar Confirms Ongoing GTA Online Support After GTA 6 Launch
item.description: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick confirmed that Rockstar Games will continue supporting GTA Online with new content and events well after GTA 6 launches, alongside massive sales milestones for GTA V and the series.

item.title: GTA 6 Pop‑up Store Opens in London, Selling Exclusive Merch
item.description: Rockstar Games partners with Selfridges for a limited‑time GTA 6 pop‑up in London, selling bags, jackets and more. The store runs Nov 9‑28, with £2,500 jacket and strict purchase limits.

item.title: GTA 6 PS5 Physical Boxes Have Hit The Wild, A Harbinger Of Our Disc-Less Future
item.description: Kotaku reports that physical PlayStation 5 boxes for Grand Theft Auto 6 have begun appearing in retail locations ahead of the November 12 street date, with the packaging confirmed to contain no physical disc and requiring an internet connection to redeem the digital download code. item.title: Report: Take‑Two forecasts 20% growth from GTA VI
item.description: Take‑Two Interactive expects GTA VI to drive a roughly 20 % revenue increase, according to a Yahoo Finance report published on Nov 7 2026. The projection highlights continued confidence in the upcoming open‑world title as the publisher also notes broader holiday booking trends. This forecast comes f

item.title: GTA 6 Box Copies Begin Arriving Early with Online Feature and New Screenshots
item.description: Physical GTA 6 copies are arriving at retailers November 12, with a 230GB install size and an online functions icon, while new screenshots showcase Lucia, Jason and a plane.

item.title: New GTA6 Screenshots Compare Real-Life Cars to In-Game Vehicles
item.description: New Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots have been released with side-by-side comparisons of real-life vehicles and in-game models, featuring West Coast Customs recreations of iconic GTA cars and Rockstar's 'Launch Gallery' drop ahead of the November 19, 2026 launch.

item.title: GTA 6 File Sizes Differ Across Xbox and PlayStation, Regional Variations Hint at Censorship
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that updated backend data shows GTA 6’s Xbox download size exceeds the PlayStation 5 version, while regional builds on both platforms vary in ways that suggest possible censorship for Japan, Australia, and New Zealand.
